item.title: How Is ‘Melania’ Playing in Minneapolis? Let’s Crunch the Numbers
item.description: The first lady's $75 million Amazon documentary just added 200 screens, expanding its theatrical run to 2,000 — with some in deep blue cities you'd never expect — before it heads to Amazon Prime, probably sometime this summer

item.title: Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh Team Up for Action Buddy Comedy ‘Mayday’
item.description: Apple TV debuted a first-look image from the film, which premieres Sept. 4 on the streamer.

item.title: Disney’s New CEO Josh D’Amaro on His Vision for Company: “I’m a Big Risk Taker”
item.description: As D'Amaro prepares to take over the Disney reins from Bob Iger, he's opening up to David Muir about the company's future under his leadership, protecting actors while embracing AI and more.

item.title: Ricky Gervais Advises Celebrities to Leave Politics Out of Speeches After Bad Bunny Slams ICE at Grammys
item.description: Billie Eilish also spoke out against ICE during her time on stage Sunday night, adding in her speech, "No one is illegal on stolen land."

item.title: Is ‘F1’ Sequel Revving Up? Apple’s Eddy Cue and Formula 1’s Stefano Domenicali Tease Film Plans
item.description: "Stay tuned,” said the Formula 1 CEO when asked to divulge plans for a sequel to the Brad Pitt-starrer that has grossed north of $600 million at the global box office.

item.title: Emerald Fennell’s ‘Wuthering Heights’: First Reactions
item.description: The Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi-starring adaptation of Emily Brontë's classic novel opens in theaters on Feb. 13.
